cohort: The study participants were pregnant women diagnosed with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM).
finding: The SFEE diet management intervention significantly improved glycemic control (fasting glucose and HbA1c), reduced macrosomia and cesarean rates, and increased dietary adherence and GDM knowledge compared to standard dietary advice.
mod_finding: The SFEE group had significantly lower cesarean section rates (18%) compared to the control group (30%).
